description: This file defines the DUEL templating engine, including type definitions, view binding, rendering, and DOM manipulation functions. It provides mechanisms for template compilation, data binding, and rendering views as HTML or DOM elements.

classes.name: Markup
classes.description: Wraps a string value to maintain as raw markup in output, providing a toString method for rendering.

classes.name: Result
classes.description: Represents a view result, capable of rendering as HTML string or DOM nodes, with methods for DOM manipulation and reloading the document.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Appends a child node or attribute object to a parent node in the template structure.

methods.name: bindContent
methods.description: Binds a template node to data, producing a fragment or value.

methods.name: loop
methods.description: Handles iteration over arrays or objects for template binding.

methods.name: xor
methods.description: Processes conditional template blocks based on a test.

methods.name: call
methods.description: Invokes another view within the template.

methods.name: part
methods.description: Replaces a placeholder part with a named partial view.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Main binding function that dispatches based on node type.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders a view as an HTML string.

methods.name: toDOM
methods.description: Converts a view into DOM nodes, optionally replacing or merging into an existing element.

methods.name: reload
methods.description: Replaces the entire document with the current view.
